subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding culture as the shared beliefs, customs, food, art, and language of a group of people
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches an example (a food, a story, a style of dress) to the cultural element category it belongs to
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what culture means and names elements of their own

misconception_flags: defines culture as only one narrow element (like food) rather than the full range of shared customs and beliefs

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
